tokens.name: studio-black
tokens.usage: Primitive. The brand black. Page ground on every ecosystem site. Use through `surface`, not directly.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Primitive. Alternate section ground. Use through `surface-alt`.

tokens.name: dark
tokens.usage: Primitive. Inputs, secondary buttons, popovers. Use through `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Primitive. Card fill. Use through `surface-card`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Primitive. Hairline dividers. Use through `line`.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Primitive. THE brand gold (official as of Sept 2026; retires the documents' #C9A84C). Use through `accent`.

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: Primitive. Hover state of gold fills; top stop of the gold gradient.

tokens.name: gold-dark
tokens.usage: Primitive. Pressed state, selection highlight, scrollbar thumb; bottom stop of the gold gradient.

tokens.name: gold-muted
tokens.usage: Primitive. Quiet gold for large text and borders only (5.0:1 on studio-black).

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Primitive. Gold dark enough to be TEXT on white or cream paper (5.4:1 on paper-card). Used by the paper theme.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Primitive. The brand's text colour on dark grounds. Use through `ink`.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Primitive. Secondary text on dark grounds. Use through `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Primitive. Document page white (invoices, proposals, handoffs).

tokens.name: paper-warm
tokens.usage: Primitive. Warm alternate band on paper; the stat strip on reports.

tokens.name: paper-card
tokens.usage: Primitive. Card and callout fill on paper.

tokens.name: paper-line
tokens.usage: Primitive. Hairlines on paper.

tokens.name: umber
tokens.usage: Primitive. Secondary text on paper (6.3:1 on white).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Everything else sits on it.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating full-width sections; sits directly on surface.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, secondary buttons, menus, popovers.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, vignettes, callouts.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card edges. Below 3:1 by design (1.4:1 on surface): never the only edge of a control; controls use `line-strong`.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen: inputs, outline buttons at rest, table rules on documents. 3:1 or more on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-alt, surface-raised and surface-card.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, risk-reversal microcopy, on all four surfaces.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Gold FILLS: primary button, header strip, active underline, badges. Put `on-accent` on it. On paper it is fill-only (2.1:1 as text on white).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Gold as TEXT: eyebrows, links, the one emphasized headline word, prices. Legible on all four surfaces in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: Selection highlight, scrollbar thumb, decorative rules.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (9.7:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed / paid / shipped status text and dots, on all four surfaces. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive fills (delete, refund). Put `on-danger` on it.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (8.6:1).

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error messages and failed status text, on all four surfaces. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px in the surface colour. 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Accent layer — Fire on the Bayou only. The ember button variant and live indicators. Never page wallpaper.

tokens.name: flame
tokens.usage: Accent layer — Fire on the Bayou. Hover of ember; hot highlights in motion work.

tokens.name: ink-deep
tokens.usage: Accent layer — Fire on the Bayou's deeper base under video (the Tailwind name there is `ink`).

tokens.name: bayou
tokens.usage: Accent layer — Fire on the Bayou's murky green-black alternate sections.

tokens.name: prairie
tokens.usage: Accent layer — Graham Hill (Roots Cinema). Replaces gold as the emphasis colour on that site only.

tokens.name: parchment
tokens.usage: Accent layer — Graham Hill light bands.

tokens.name: nola-red
tokens.usage: Accent layer — Doug Belote. Section rules and badges; as text only 24px+.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Cormorant Garamond, light (300), tight leading. Headings on every ecosystem site. Hosted on Google Fonts (weights 300, 400, 600; italic 300, 400).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: The room where the record gets made
styles.usage: Home-page hero headline only (text-7xl). One per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.sample: Sessions that pay before they start

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Section H2s on home pages (text-5xl): outcome-voiced, one emphasized word.

styles.name: emphasis
styles.usage: The ONE emphasized word inside a heading: italic 400 in `accent-text`, same size as its heading.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: A working studio in Mid-City with two rooms, a vocal booth and engineers who answer the phone.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bring your stems. We'll send a session plan the same day.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: The workhorse: cards, forms, nav, table cells (text-sm, the most-used size).

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Deposit refundable until your session is confirmed
styles.usage: Risk-reversal microcopy, metadata (text-xs) in `ink-muted`, never bold.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: UPPERCASE kicker above headings and table heads, in `accent-text` (tracking-widest / 0.14em).

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Invoice and proposal numbers, repo slugs, timestamps in vignettes.

spacing.note: 4px base; the Tailwind steps the repos actually use most (3, 6, 2, 4, 1).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: label to input, eyebrow to heading.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum page gutter on phones; input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (default size).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (p-6); grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large button padding; gap between card groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Heading to section content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a full section (py-24).

radius.note: Square-edged brand: 2px on almost everything, pills only for avatars and dots.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed media, header bars, document tables.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Default for buttons, cards, badges, inputs (rounded-sm, 207 uses).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, status dots, engineer photos (rounded-full).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting card.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Card hover (`card-lift`): pair with a 4px upward move over duration-base.

tokens.name: shadow-vignette
tokens.usage: Cinematic hero edge darkening (`.vignette`). Studio only.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in the surface colour, then a 2px `focus` ring.

duration.note: Motion is slow and cinematic. Respect prefers-reduced-motion: drop to 0ms.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Colour and opacity changes on hover.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Card lift, button state, menu open.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Section fade-up on scroll (the most-used duration).

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Hero entrance and staggered headline reveals.

tokens.name: duration-scroll
tokens.usage: Lenis smooth-scroll duration (duration 1.2).

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entrances, reveals, card lift.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Hover colour changes.
